channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: High school teacher finds T. rex tracks in North Dakota
item.description: Denver Museum of Nature & Science research associate Kent Hups discusses his discovery of T. rex footprints in the Badlands.

item.title: UN experts: US may have committed war crimes in Iran strikes
item.description: UN-appointed rights experts say there are reasonable grounds to believe the US committed war crimes in strikes that killed many Iranians.

item.title: Buffett to step down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Warren Buffett announced in a letter to shareholders on Friday that he is stepping aside as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway.

item.title: Diesel prices hit record highs amid Strait of Hormuz disruption and Russia-Ukraine war
item.description: As of Friday morning, the average price for a gallon of diesel remained near a record high of $6.43, according to the latest data.
